gitCommit.subject: Prefill signup email from landing page CTA
gitCommit.body:
Prefill signup email from landing page CTA

The hero/CTA forms submit the typed email as a query param to
new_user_path, but UsersController#new ignored it, so visitors landed
on a blank signup form. Prefill @user.email from the param instead.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
